correctness.rationale: The simplex-by-simplex barycentric formula is a global glued D_n-equivariant SDR. The core link cycles, integral orientation two-cycle, f-vector and Euler formula give a torus. Reflection-fixed simplex counts and free rotation action prove four order-two branch orbits, with Riemann-Hurwitz giving sphere quotient. The integer H1 action follows from signed Lefschetz traces and finite-order matrices. The standalone checker verifies structural steps independently for n=9..24, without extrapolating from finite tests.
